req.title: Include Content-Length on echo responses
req.statement: The system shall include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length on echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length. Tests cover: (1) positive EP cases for each method verifying Content-Length presence and exact value match, (2) negative/boundary cases verifying the header value is numeric and non-zero for non-empty bodies, (3) boundary cases verifying Content-Length matches len(data) exactly (off-by-one kills), (4) POST with body payload to ensure Content-Length reflects actual body size, (5) exact arithmetic assertion that Content-Length == len(response.data) to catch constant/arithmetic mutations.

tests.name: test_get_content_length_present_and_exact
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_content_length_present_and_exact():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    body_len = len(r.data)
    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl > 0

test_get_content_length_present_and_exact()

tests.name: test_content_length_is_integer_string_not_empty
actions: Attempt to parse Content-Length as int
Verify it is not empty string, not negative, not zero
expected: Content-Length header is a valid positive integer string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_is_integer_string_not_empty():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl_str = r.headers['Content-Length']
    assert cl_str != ''
    cl = int(cl_str)
    assert cl > 0
    assert cl != 0
    assert cl == len(r.data)

test_content_length_is_integer_string_not_empty()

tests.name: test_content_length_matches_utf8_byte_length_not_char_length
preconditions: Response body is UTF-8 encoded JSON
actions: Send GET /get with query param containing multibyte chars
expected: Content-Length equals byte length of body, not character count
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_matches_utf8_byte_length_not_char_length():
    r = client.get('/get?q=hello')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    raw_bytes = r.data
    byte_len = len(raw_bytes)
    assert cl == byte_len
    assert cl != len(raw_bytes.decode('utf-8'))

test_content_length_matches_utf8_byte_length_not_char_length()

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_have_content_length
preconditions: All five echo endpoints are available
actions: Send appropriate request to each of /get /post /put /patch /delete
For each: assert status 200, Content-Length present, Content-Length == len(data)
expected: All five endpoints return 200 with correct Content-Length
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_have_content_length():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get', None),
        ('POST', '/post', None),
        ('PUT', '/put', None),
        ('PATCH', '/patch', None),
        ('DELETE', '/delete', None),
    ]
    for method, path, body in cases:
        r = getattr(client, method.lower())(path)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} status={r.status_code}'
        assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers, f'{method} {path} missing Content-Length'
        cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
        assert cl == len(r.data), f'{method} {path} cl={cl} body={len(r.data)}'
        assert cl > 0, f'{method} {path} Content-Length must be > 0'

test_all_echo_endpoints_have_content_length()

tests.name: test_post_large_body_content_length_exact
actions: Send POST /post with a larger JSON body
expected: Content-Length is exact byte count for larger response body
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_large_body_content_length_exact():
    large_payload = json.dumps({'data': 'x' * 1000})
    r = client.post('/post', data=large_payload, content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Content-Length' in r.headers
    cl = int(r.headers['Content-Length'])
    body_len = len(r.data)
    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl != body_len - 1
    assert cl != body_len + 1
    assert body_len > 1000

test_post_large_body_content_length_exact()

tests.name: test_content_length_header_name_case_insensitive_present
actions: Verify value is numeric and matches body
expected: Content-Length header exists and equals body byte length
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_length_header_name_case_insensitive_present():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
    assert 'content-length' in headers_lower
    cl = int(headers_lower['content-length'])
    body_len = len(r.data)
    assert cl == body_len
    assert cl > 0

test_content_length_header_name_case_insensitive_present()
